verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a SaaS notarization and incorporation service. Publishing its source under an open license is a fair question for a product of this kind, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only a proprietary API, webhooks and llms.txt docs, with no mention of a public repository, source code or an open-source license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
